overview: The Temporal Fracture Chamber is the epicenter of Akhevan chronomantic collapse.
details: Void resonance ruptured the Akhevan temporal lattice, creating unstable time fields and anomaly entities that flicker between timelines.
hooks: A temporal fracture expands toward the Xi Vius halls.
Void rifts open and close unpredictably.
An anomaly manifests as a distorted Akhevan priest.
Chronomantic glyphs activate after centuries of silence.
